title: Top Toaster Ovens That Replace the Big Oven (2026)
summary: These five toaster ovens are recommended by multiple expert sources for their ability to replace a full-size oven for most daily cooking tasks.
method: Picks were selected based on recommendations from Consumer Reports, Good Housekeeping, CNET, ShouldIt, The Guardian, and Epicurious. Products recommended by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: No prices are listed in the provided source excerpts. Availability and specific model variants may vary by region.

products.name: Breville Joule Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro
why: This oven is named Best Overall by Good Housekeeping, The Guardian, and Epicurious. It is described as a premium experience with high-end build and precise operation.
It functions as an air fryer thanks to added convection fans. It is noted for its versatility in baking, roasting, and broiling.
products.desc: A high-end countertop oven with air frying capabilities. It features convection fans and multiple cooking modes. It is designed to replace a full-size oven for many tasks.
products.benefit: Picture a home cook who wants to roast vegetables or bake cookies without heating up the whole house. This oven handles those tasks with precise operation and a high-end build. It beats other picks by being the consensus Best Overall across three major sources. The catch: it is positioned as a premium option, implying a higher cost than budget alternatives.
pros: Named Best Overall by multiple sources
cons: May be overkill for simple toasting
products.best_for: Buyers wanting a versatile, high-performance oven to replace their main oven.
products.skip_if: You are on a strict budget or only need basic toasting.

products.name: Cuisinart Air Fryer + Convection Toaster Oven
why: Good Housekeeping names this the Best Air Fryer Toaster Oven. It is also mentioned in the context of the Cuisinart TOA-70 being a top choice for high-end build and competitive price.
It offers precise operation and excellent cooking performance. It is a strong contender for those prioritizing air frying features.
products.desc: A toaster oven with dedicated air fryer and convection functions. It is designed for versatile cooking including air frying. It is noted for its competitive price relative to its build quality.
products.benefit: Picture a user who wants crisp results on frozen foods like waffles or fries without a separate air fryer. This model provides that function with precise operation. It beats the Breville in terms of price competitiveness while maintaining high-end build qualities. The catch: it is not the consensus Best Overall, though it is highly rated for air frying.
pros: Best Air Fryer Toaster Oven per Good Housekeeping
cons: Not the overall top pick in all sources
products.best_for: Buyers who prioritize air frying capabilities and value for money.
products.skip_if: You need the absolute highest-end smart features of the Breville.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 6-in-1 Sure Crisp Air Fryer Toaster Oven
why: Good Housekeeping identifies this as the Best Value pick. It is a 6-in-1 appliance that includes air frying.
It is recommended for buyers looking for a cost-effective option that still offers multiple cooking functions.
products.desc: A 6-in-1 toaster oven with air fryer capabilities. It is designed for versatile cooking at a lower price point. It offers multiple functions in one compact unit.
products.benefit: Picture a renter or small household that needs a versatile appliance without a large investment. This oven provides six functions including air frying. It beats the premium picks by offering core functionality at a better value. The catch: it may lack the advanced smart features or build quality of the Breville or Cuisinart.
cons: Less premium build than top picks
products.best_for: Budget-conscious buyers who want multiple cooking modes.
products.skip_if: You require high-end smart controls or premium build materials.

verdict.pick: Breville Joule Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro
verdict.line: This is the top pick for most buyers because it is named Best Overall by Good Housekeeping, The Guardian, and Epicurious. It offers high-end features and precise operation, but it is a premium option compared to the budget picks.
